item.title: Datto SaaS Protection - All Regions/V3 Pods - Maintenance Notice - Microsoft Graph API Migration [maintenance]
item.description:
The maintenance window for the planned migration from Exchange Web Services (EWS) to Microsoft Graph APIs has been extended through Friday, September 11, 2026.
As part of the ongoing migration effort, the R&D team has increased the Exchange backup cadence from 2x backups per day to 3x backups per day. To help maintain backup stability and high success rates during the maintenance period, backup cadence for SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive has been temporarily reduced to 1x backup per day.
Customers may continue to experience temporary backup performance degradation for Exchange services, as well as reduced backup activity for SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive, during the maintenance period.
We will continue to provide updates as progress is made and appreciate your patience while this work

item.title: Datto EDR — Elevated Alert Volume — "Possible Shim Database Persistence via sdbinst.exe" [postmortem]
item.description:
**Datto EDR - Mass Detection on Windows Behavior – 2026-08-27**
**Summary**
Between **2026-08-27 08:00 UTC** and **2026-08-27 16:00 UTC**, Datto EDR customers experienced an elevated volume of detections generated by the **Possible Shim Database Persistence via sdbinst.exe** detection rule. The increase in alerts created additional operational overhead for customers and analysts reviewing alerts. No service outage occurred, and endpoint protection functionality remained operational throughout the event. The issue was resolved after the detection rule was updated to account for a newly observed legitimate Windows operating system behavior.
**Root Cause**
A legitimate Microsoft Windows behavior involving **sdbinst.exe** and the file path **C:\\Windows\\appcompat\\cloudsdb\\apppatch.
